Ana (Design): Hey all — quick UX idea for rollout fallback: add a 'silent safety‑net' toggle that lets a rollout degrade automatically but suppresses oncall pings and customer-facing error banners. It would still record audit events and surface in console telemetry.
Matt (Eng): I like the idea. Important Q: does "silent" mean no alerts at all, or just no paging but an event+metric still emitted?
Li (SRE): must still emit a metric + a structured event. We need a durable audit log for forensic playback. No pages unless the fallback rate exceeds X%.
Rachael (PM): Proposed behavior: silent = no pages, no public banner, but internal Console shows a red stripe and a link to rollout trace. If fallback > 5% for 10m -> escalate (page).
DeployBot: [deploy] rollout/2026-03-21T09:10 started by @rachael :rocket:
Oliver (Eng-Platform): UI concerns: users will expect to toggle per-rollout AND have an org-wide default. We should show effective policy with breadcrumbs: org default -> service override -> rollout override.
Ana (Design): Agreed. Visual suggestion: a compact chip 'Silent safety‑net (audit-only)' with tooltip and a small info icon linking to the audit playback.
Matt (Eng): Backend config proposal (simple YAML) — for audit + sample telemetry:

```
fallback_policy:
  mode: silent        # silent | notify | strict
  audit_log: true
  metrics: true
  alert_threshold_pct: 5
  alert_window_minutes: 10
  sample_debug_rate: 0.02   # fraction of fallback requests captured fully
```

Would that be usable?
Li (SRE): yes, but make sample_debug_rate adjustable per-rollout and per-customer. We need some captured traces for quality/regression checks. Also retention policy: audit events >= 90 days for enterprise customers.
Maria (Legal): FYI — audit retention has compliance implications. For EU customers we need to allow configurable retention and data export. Also need opt-out controls for PII in the captured debug samples.
Sam (Ops): On the ops side, please add an explicit 'replay' button in the Console next to the rollout so an SRE can playback inputs (redacted) to reproduce fallback conditions. Access control needed.
Oliver (Eng-Platform): Telemetry side: we should emit a single timeseries 'fallback_rate{mode="silent|notify|strict", rollout_id=...}' and a histogram for latencies when fallback happens. Also an event stream for each sampled debug capture with fields: rollout_id, reason, model_variant_from, model_variant_to, request_hash.
Rachael (PM): UX tradeoffs: silent mode reduces noise for mobile teams that have aggressive canaries. We should add an inline explanation: "Silent = no pages, still recorded and visible in Console; escalates if sustained". Also add a CTA to 'preview audit' which shows a sample of the last 10 fallback events.
Matt (Eng): One more: operators will want a 'quiet window' schedule (e.g., midnight batch runs) where silent is the default. Maybe reuse existing schedule config.
Ana (Design): I'll mock a small panel: toggle + severity slider + sample-rate input + 'preview audit' modal. Will share tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Li (SRE): I'll list what we need from the runtime: RPC to set sample rate, event schema, and a compact replay API endpoint.
Ol i ver (Eng-Platform): (typo) Oliver: I'll draft API shapes. Quick question — should silent fallbacks still consume the same billing tier (cost) or be tagged differently? Billing needs to know fallback counts.
Sam (Ops): Tag them — we'll need to reconcile costs by rollout to chargebacks.
Rachael (PM): Decision checklist: 1) per-rollout toggle + org default, 2) telemetry metrics + audit stream, 3) replay + RBAC, 4) EU retention controls, 5) alert escalation thresholds. Anyone object?
Maria (Legal): No objections. Add guidance text about PII redaction.
Matt (Eng): No objections. I'll prototype the config + telemetry emitter and post RFC next week.
Ana (Design): Thanks — will post mocks in #design tomorrow.
DeployBot: [info] audit_stream: created (rollout/2026-03-21T09:10)
Rachael (PM): Thanks everyone. Short sync on Friday if needed. :calendar:
